Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Commercial packet for Lumen Health — estimate + deck

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for the time today. As promised, attaching the commercial packet so your procurement and infra teams have a single place to review pricing, capacity assumptions, and the recommended rollout plan. Quick recap from our discovery call: 

• Primary goal: reduce inference latency on the clinical triage pipeline while controlling cost growth as usage scales.
• Current constraints: batch inference on GPU VMs with 1s median latency; sensitive PHI controls required (VPC + customer-managed KMS).
• Recommended Redwood approach: Dedicated capacity with autoscale windows, prefix caching for short sequences, and an evaluation window to validate quality/regression.

What I attached: 
- redwood_pricing_deck_v2.pdf — per-tier pricing, example throughput, and quantization options
- lumen_estimate_DL-9874.xlsx — breakout by model size, expected tokens/month, and forecasted monthly spend

Suggested next steps:
1) Quick 15–20 minute walkthrough of the deck with your procurement and infra teams to align on assumptions (I can run this).
2) If the numbers look good, we can draft a mutual action plan and calendar a pilot start date for early January.

Proposed slots: Wed 12/1 10:30–10:50am PT, Thu 12/2 2:00–2:20pm PT, or Mon 12/6 11:00–11:20am PT. If none of those work, tell me a couple times that do.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_deck_v2.pdf (15 pages), lumen_estimate_DL-9874.xlsx (pricing sheet)

Thanks — happy to clarify any line-items.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
